posts.zh:
dsh-lark 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 机器人渠道：每个会话驱动独立 agent，工具审批、模型提问与计划审阅都以卡片回到聊天，点按钮或直接回复即可作答；聊天里用 `/cd`、`/model`、`/new` 切工作区、换模型、重开会话，多个机器人各自独立并可在同群交接回合。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6f00d3caa7734882654e.html
posts.en:
dsh-lark is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Lark/Feishu bot channel for DeepSeek Harness: each chat drives its own agent, and tool approvals, model questions, and plan reviews return as cards answered by a button or a reply. Switch workspace and model from the chat (`/cd`, `/model`, `/new`), and run several bots that keep separate sessions and can hand turns to each other in one group.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6f00d3caa7734882654e.html
